none.description: Apply Regeneration to every eligible friendly living stack. For 3 rounds, mark 25% + 0.15% x Spell Power of damage suffered by surviving creatures as Regenerable, up to 50%; Nature Magic rank scales only the Spell Power term and Herbalist adds 10 percentage points before the cap. Restore marked health at the start of the stack's next activation; casualties cannot be restored. Granted only by Verdant Communion; costs three times Regeneration's listed Mana cost before Wisdom.
